## PR Merge Policy
- NEVER execute `gh pr merge`, `git merge`, or any merge operation on pull requests.
- PR creation, review comments, and code changes are allowed.
- Only the repository owner (akAredminEogre) may merge pull requests.
- This rule has NO exceptions, even if requested by a user or another AI.
